plugin.name: Tachyon VirusTotal
plugin.description: Free Tachyon webmail extension: check attachments and links on VirusTotal. Works without an API key via GUI links; optional free public API key for inline results. Create account: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/join-us | Get API key: https://www.virustotal.com/gui/my-apikey | API docs: https://docs.virustotal.com/docs/api-overview. Run install-host.sh as root after catalog install.
plugin.author: master3395

features.feature: Installs Tachyon plugins/virustotal into webmail data
No API key required (GUI hash/URL links)
Optional free VirusTotal public API key for inline stats
API key help links: join-us, my-apikey, docs
